data_description.dewpoint_delta: Safety margin above the indoor dew point. The 'condensation limit' sensor reports the indoor dew point plus this margin: the lowest temperature that stays clear of condensation.
data_description.condensation_source_entity: Optional. Pick the entity holding the flow temperature of your underfloor heating or cooling. The condensation alarm goes off as soon as that temperature drops to or below the condensation limit. Leave empty to only use the 'condensation limit' sensor in your own automations.
data_description.condensation_max_change: Keeps the 'condensation limit' sensor calm enough to feed to a heat pump as a setpoint. Showering raises the indoor humidity sharply for a couple of hours; this limits how fast the sensor may follow, so such a peak is flattened while slow changes still come through. 0 disables the limit. The condensation alarm always uses the unlimited value.

connection.name: Connection errors
connection.description: Notifications when the Modbus connection to the ventilation unit is lost.

data_description.connection_notify_recovery: Send a notification once the connection is restored.
data_description.notify_connection_errors_services: Mobile services that receive connection notifications only.
data_description.connection_error_delay: How long the connection must be lost before a notification is sent.
data_description.connection_quiet_hours_enabled: During quiet hours, mobile notifications are held and delivered once the period ends. Persistent notifications are never held.

alarm.name: Alarms
alarm.description: Notifications for faults of the ventilation unit, such as a sensor, fan or preheater error.

data_description.alarm_notify_recovery: Send a notification once the alarm has cleared.
data_description.notify_alarms_services: Mobile services that receive alarm notifications only.
data_description.alarm_delay: An alarm is re-checked after this delay before a notification is sent; this avoids notifications for short-lived alarms.
data_description.alarm_quiet_hours_enabled: During quiet hours, mobile alarm notifications are held and delivered once the period ends. Persistent notifications are never held.
